input.body:
## Summary

Connect originala910619's timed rejection effect, stacked on #97.

```text
invalid selection → independent91-frame effect at224,196
backdrop / title / reason → separate authored alpha tracks
pointer → shielded, no dismiss handler or inert modal
frame91 → remove clip; keyboard additions can overlap
```

## Evidence

- **Before:** the new mock regression fails because invalid selection creates no timed effect.
  **After:** authored fade starts, last-visible-frame/removal, independent overlap and pointer shielding pass in both asset modes. No rejection dialog or dismiss action remains; unrelated offline/service dialogs stay intact.
- Formatting, TypeScript,581 rule/parser tests (6,646 assertions), production build and all12 distinct affected supplied-SWF/mock browser cases pass across broad/focused runs, without skips (12 cases1.2minutes; final pair14.2seconds).
- Final tests inspect actual page pixels for visible fading heading and reason, alongside exact alpha/frame assertions. Native/mock captures inspected. Five stage listeners return to zero on unmount.
- Overlay component matches originala910619. Existing stage CSS/source corrections were preserved; only11 overlay rules added. Two independent native caches increase viewer entries124→126; reason text remains separate. No generated data or media changes.
- All13 original checkpoint paths are accounted across #97/this PR, pending merges. Effects currently belong to the viewer; source global mainEffects persistence/cross-screen hierarchy, exact Adobe event phase, mock typography and full-game parity remain explicit gaps.

## Merge Danger

**Door:** two-way

Revert restores the earlier dismissible rejection-message adapter.

**Blast Radius:** viewer

Selection rejection input/paint/lifetimes and two artwork caches. Eligibility rules and unrelated notifications remain unchanged.
